title: SAML2 connector setup: RBAC-aware metadata exchange playbook and validator
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Define and implement a guided SAML 2.0 connector setup flow that performs live metadata exchange, validates assertions and certificates, enforces RBAC v2 admin scoping during initial sync, and writes rich audit events for each step. Scope: interactive web flow in Console + CLI dry-run mode + server-side validation endpoint. Out of scope: full IdP provisioning automation and OIDC connectors. Motivation: Customers repeatedly misconfigure metadata (cert rotation, entityID mismatches, NameID format) leading to broken SSO and noisy support tickets. This task reduces operator error by: (1) running automated signature & cert chain checks on uploaded metadata, (2) validating ACS/EntityID round-trip using a test AuthnRequest/Response, (3) surfacing RBAC scoping choices to admins before the first user sync, and (4) emitting audit logs for every validation/fallback decision. Deliverables: backend validation service (POST /internal/sso/saml/validate), Console UI changes to present validation issues and recommended fixes, CLI dry-run command (redwood saml validate --file metadata.xml), test harness for IdP replay with simulated clock skew, and a short runbook for support and SRE teams.
acceptance_criteria: Console accepts metadata via upload or URL and returns a detailed validation report within 6s for standard metadata sizes (<50KB)
Server returns structured validation codes for: missing entityID, invalid cert signature, unsupported digest algorithm, expired cert, ACS mismatch, and clock skew warnings
RBAC v2 admin chooser is shown during connector creation and is persisted so subsequent automated syncs respect the chosen admin scope

Audit events are emitted to the audit log for: metadata uploaded, validation passed/failed, test-authnrequest executed, RBAC scope selected, and connector created; events include connector_id, initiator, timestamp, validation_codes
CLI dry-run produces same validation codes and a human-friendly remediation hint file
End-to-end tests simulate an IdP with rotated certs and assert the flow surfaces 'certificate rotation detected' with remediation steps
Security review sign-off completed and automated fuzz tests pass in CI
steps: Design API schema for validation results (validation_code, severity, message, hint_url)
Implement server-side validator library reusing existing XML signature libs and adding cert chain verification and algorithm allowlists
Add an AuthnRequest test harness that can send a signed AuthnRequest and handle a test Response to validate ACS/entityID routing
Wire validation endpoint to Console upload flow with progressive disclosure of issues and suggested fixes
Add RBAC v2 admin scoping selector with explanatory tooltip and store selection on connector creation
Emit audit events to existing audit pipeline; include diff of original metadata vs normalized metadata
Add CLI command and documentation page; include examples for common IdP vendors and fallback recommendations
Create integration tests for: valid metadata, missing certificate, signed assertions with wrong key, expired cert, and clock skew +/-10s
notes: Prefer non-blocking warnings for clock skew up to 30s but fail for >5m unless admin explicitly allows skew-tolerant mode
Be conservative about automatic fixes; always present a remediation hint and require admin confirmation for destructive actions
We will reuse parts of ENG-45567 (audit schema v2) to avoid duplicating event formats
Consider adding telemetry counters: validation_invocations, validation_failures_by_code, average_validation_latency
Initial implementation should support XML metadata and metadata URLs with redirects; SFTP/SCIM ingest out of scope
Consult with Legal on retention windows for metadata copies in audit logs (likely 90 days)

2026-03-06 Liam O'Connor: Implementing validator and harness; prototyping XML signature verification with xmlsec. Found vendor-specific quirks for Azure AD metadata with multiple KeyDescriptors — will add heuristics.

2026-03-08 Design review (Marta Ruiz): UX suggested progressive validation with collapsible sections to avoid overwhelming admins. Also asked for a clear 'skip and create' path gated by RBAC permission.
2026-03-10 Security review (Rahul Mehta): flagged usage of SHA1 in some legacy IdP metadata. Decision: fail SHA1 signatures unless tenant enables legacy-compat feature and signs a waiver.

2026-03-11 Liam O'Connor: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3287 implementing validation service skeleton and audit event wiring. Unit tests added for cert expiration and missing entityID. Needs integration tests and Console wiring.

2026-03-12 QA (Sophie Zhang): Ran dry-run against test IdP farm. Found a timing flake when test harness signs AuthnRequest with system clock skew; added retry with clock-offset negotiation to harness.
2026-03-12 Product (Jordan Bell): Confirmed acceptance criteria and requested logging of admin choice so Support can advise customers during onboarding.
